$comment: Private-target allowlist for scripts/link-check (issue #149). External URLs are never fetched by the gate (walled/anti-bot surfaces answer 403 to bots, #132), so a private family repo needs an explicit declaration, not a resolution. `target` must be an http(s) URL (validated). Each entry records WHY the target is private and the TRIGGER that removes it; a declared target nothing in scope references is reported as W-ALLOWLIST-UNUSED so the registry cannot rot silently (the entry for `profile-data-template` was removed that way, #273). This file is data, not a manifest: Dependabot does not read it. Empty since #273: `profile-data-template` went public (verified 2026-10-23: `gh repo view ChristianLuciani/profile-data-template --json visibility` -> PUBLIC, HTTP 200), so its removal trigger fired and every on-ramp A link now resolves for a stranger.
